name: better-seo
description: Audit, set up and measure a site's SEO: page and site-wide search visibility, agentic-search readiness, missing config, plus Search Console and Core Web Vitals data.

interface.shortDescription: SEO audit, SEO setup, and real search data.
interface.longDescription: Three skills: better-seo audits a page or a whole site and checks AI-crawler policy, better-seo-build scaffolds robots, sitemap, llms.txt, meta tags and JSON-LD in the project's own framework, better-seo-data reads Search Console and Core Web Vitals when credentials exist and says so plainly when they do not.
